title: Simple and effective app to build yourself up
body:
I enjoy the simplicity and effectiveness that this app brings to my habit management. It offers features you need to form a good habit or break a bad one such as habit stacking, flexible notification setup and much more.

The thing I like the most is It's super simple mood log which doubles as journaling tool. I can track my mood across time in 2 taps and optionally add a short description.

With this being said, I'd like to see a bit better logic around syncing with Apple Watch. Even though it's not a huge deal to re-open the app on the watch in order to sync it but I know it can be better.

Keep up the good work!
author: _jaksm
